name: Known suppliers: how stores order from them
source: Chedam, from the suppliers' public pages (cokecanada.com, pepsicopartners.com, contact.pepsico.com), checked 2026-10-11; confirm with your sales rep
rows: coke coca-cola cocacola coca cola sprite fanta dasani minute maid powerade monster

Coke Canada delivers to the store itself (direct store delivery). Existing customers place orders with the Customer Sales Solutions Centre (phone) or on myCoke, Coke Canada's ordering site (ask the centre to set up your myCoke login; it also has invoices and payment). New customers: sellcoke@cokecanada.com. Ordering by EDI or an API is only for large chains.
pepsi pepsico 7up mountain dew gatorade aquafina bubly lipton tropicana brisk

Customers register on PepsiCo Partners (account number needed; 1-800-963-2424 if you don't know it) and order beverages there, with delivery on scheduled days; a rep or the driver can also take the order. To become a customer: 1-855-PEPSI-4U (1-855-737-7448). Ordering by EDI or an API is only for large chains.
frito lay fritolay lays lay's doritos cheetos ruffles tostitos sunchips miss vickie's smartfood quaker

Snacks come by direct store delivery: the route sales rep or driver visits on set days, checks the shelf and takes the order. PepsiCo Partners did not offer snacks (food) for online ordering in Canada when checked. Ask your rep for the visit days and the order cut-off. Ordering by EDI or an API is only for large chains.
